title: Self Growth (Life's Path, #1)
author: Purushothaman Kollam
target_audience: Individuals seeking personal growth and self-improvement
Readers interested in holistic approaches to self-development
People looking for daily motivation and inspiration
Adults of any age exploring practical life advice
core_themes: Holistic growth: physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual aspects
primary_purpose: To inspire and guide readers towards personal transformation by offering practical strategies, philosophical reflections, and motivational advice for living a more fulfilling life.

structure_format.organization: Divided into short, digestible chapters, each focusing on a key aspect or tip for self-growth

key_concepts_lessons: Personal growth is a lifelong journey requiring commitment and self-awareness.
Positive thoughts and attitudes serve as the foundation for a successful and meaningful life.
Setting clear goals and taking small, consistent steps leads to sustainable progress.
Emotional resilience and adaptation are essential for overcoming life’s challenges.
Inner peace and contentment are as important as external achievements.
notable_features: Combines motivational quotes with actionable advice
Focus on whole-person development (mind, body, spirit)
Designed as the first part of a multi-book series
cultural_historical_context: Written in the early 2010s by an author from India, the book blends universal self-improvement concepts with Eastern philosophies and values, targeting a global audience interested in both practical and spiritual dimensions of growth.
reception_impact: Appreciated by readers for its straightforward and uplifting guidance
Considered an accessible introduction to self-help and personal growth
Valued for its emphasis on holistic well-being
Less known in mainstream Western markets, more popular in digital and Indian self-help circles
comparable_titles: The Monk Who Sold His Ferrari by Robin Sharma
Awaken the Giant Within by Tony Robbins
The Power of Positive Thinking by Norman Vincent Peale
